div.i: The expectation is blank for January 2024, which has no earlier month, so its line starts in February. Outlined: the months whose expense exceeds the expectation by more than a fifth, February 2024, whose expectation rests on the start-up month alone, and the six months with three pay dates, from March 2024 on. The value axis starts at zero. The expectation is drawn dashed here, so the two lines differ by more than color. Power BI draws both solid unless a line's style is changed.
